Tooth Cliff Station is a station on Coopol Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Internal Sea. Passengers may also use this station to change to Shore Tip LRT Tung Wik Line, Ting Wik Line (Tung Ngai Garden Stop).

Top Hill Bay Station is a station on Oasis Bay Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Oasis Bay. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 2410 (Top Hill Bay Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first station to be built in 2020.
  • The name and design of this station corresponds to the Top Quark, one of the six types of Quarks.[2] To correspond to the elements of "Top", the following elements are incorporated:
    • The Red Wool of the Platforms are located at the top location of each pillar
    • The Station Signs are hung from above instead of suspended from below like in other stations.
  • Among the six Quark-themed stations on Oasis Bay Line (Between this station and Bottom Woods), this station has the highest altitude at Y=90.

History[]

  • January 1 2020: This Station began services.
  • May 3 2020: Exit C is added to this station, which features a short-range teleporter.[3]

Fun Facts[]

  • Torrents, as well as the Chinese Name of this station, refer to fast flowing streams or of water or heavy rain. As a result, the Chinese Name of this Station is both a Sense-for-sense Translation and Homophonic Translation of the English Name. White Wool is used in this station as White Bubbles are usually seen at the tops of Rogue Waves, which could also be interpreted as fast flowing streams of water.[2]
  • The Stained Glass behind the Platforms and the Iron Bars behind the Tracks Alludes to Virtel Heights Station.[3]

title: Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu
safeHtml:
Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu, also known as Tokyo Dentetsu, Tokyu (Formerly named Mass Transport Railway System Company and abbreviated as MTRSC or MTR), is one of the operators involved in the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It was formerly named Circle Rails (CLR) and took part in development in Periods 1, 2 and 5 of the Co-Op Railway.

Operations[]

Railway[]

  • Downtown Loop Line: A line built in Period 1 of the Co-Op Railway.
  • Tokaido Line: A line built in Period 2 of the Co-Op Railway.
  • Southern Peck Line: A line planned in Period 5 of the Co-Op Railway, but never completed. Due to historical reasons, the owner gave up the development of this line, and transferred the construction and ownership rights to CTRD, forming a new line (which is the present-day Peckern South-East Coast Line).

Tower Isle is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is a subsidiary isle of Stem Island, which forms a part of the Note Group.

Location[]

Tower Isle is located to the northwest of Stem Island, the south of Heeled Island and the north of Caver Island. As a result, the West Ring Line Cavel Tunnel also passes under this isle, and the Tower Isle Vent is set up here.

Town Centre (Tong King) Stop is a stop of Tin Kam Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT, and is located at Los Sengas Peckern North Tin Shek.

Contents

  • 2 History

History[]

  • May 8 2024: This Stop began construction.
  • May 16 2024: This Stop completed construction.
  • May 17 2024: This Stop began services.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Stop does not have any exits or structure on the ground level.
  • As all the exits of this station face the same direction and are next to each other, they are seen as the same exit. A similar arrangement was also seen at Finnick Station.
  • Despite the fact that Nazca Railway uses American English normally, this Stop is named "Centre" (British English) instead of "Center" as requested by the Peckern North developers.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station was originally planned to be the southbound terminus of Stadow Line.[2]
  • This Station is the southernmost Station on West Metropolis Archipelago.
  • This Station is the only Underground Station that uses Classic PSDs in West Metropolis Archipelago.
  • Eleven Character Pillars Similar to that in Boundary Island Station are constructed at the concourse in the shape of the Kabbalah Tree of Life, a Kabbalah concept upon which the Japanese Light Novel Series Date A Live is based on. Their buildling materials, and their corresponding characters, are listed as follows based on the nodes of the Kabbalah Tree of Life. It should however be noticed that all character pillars contain white stained glass, Quartz Stairs and Quartz Slabs at the top, with Pillar Quartz Blocks at the center of each pillar:

Traveller City Transit Railway, abbreviated as TCTR, was one of the operators involved in the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. While it was established with the purpose of taking over OasisPaw Line, which was operated by Great City Railway, TCTR had lost the qualification as a Co-Op Railway Operator, and OasisPaw Line was in turn handed over to Phantasia Metro.

History[]

  • Unknown: Established.
  • May-June 2021: Took over OasisPaw Line of Great City Railway.
  • April 2022: Lost qualification as a Co-Op Railway. OasisPaw Line taken over by Phantasia Metro.

Former Operations[]

Railway[]

  • OasisPaw Line: A line handed over to Traveller City Transit Railway that was built in Period 3 of the Co-Op Railway. Now handed over to Phantasia Metro.

Light Railway[]

Traverse Parkway is one of the unnumbered Routes in Los Sengas. It runs within Peckern Continent, between Stone Shoal and Intus Occident.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Sections
    • 2.1 Nam Wui Section
    • 2.2 Chung Wui Section
    • 2.3 Congorge Section
    • 2.4 Proyga Section
    • 2.5 Polywood Section
    • 2.6 Intus Occident Section
  • 3 Districts Served
  • 4 Gallery
  • 5 Citations and References

History[]

Due to missing historical records, only the history of this road starting from 2022 will be recorded:

  • Beginning of 2022: Traverse Parkway began construction.
  • December 2022: Traverse Parkway completed construction between Nam Wui Section and Intus Occident Section.

Sections[]

As most of this road consisted of different reconstructed roads in Peckern Continent throughout different time periods, the sectioning of this road is highly complex, and most of the Sections are less than 2km long.

Nam Wui Section[]

Formerly as Yat Wah Road, it starts at the south of the junction with Gull Woods Road and Stone Shoal Road, traverses through residential buildings in the Peckern Sub-District and ends at Chu Ka Wui Road. Exits accessing the Peckern Viaduct will be added in the future. This Section is 1.5 km long.

Chung Wui Section[]

Formerly Grand Squirrel Boulevard and Proyga Road to the east of Congorge. It starts at Chu Ka Wui Road, passes through the Peckern Continent Sign to the north of the Peckern Triangle and run parallel with the bus rapid transit system "GreenLink", and ends at the entrance of the Congorge Tunnel. Moreover, a bus terminus is set up near Grand Squirrel Checkpoint, but the buses could only exit the Bus Terminus on its East end. This Section is 1.8 km long.

Congorge Section[]

This Section includes the Congorge Tunnel and ends at Proyga Stadium Road. Starting from this section, the Traverse Parkway becomes the newly built roadways. This Section assists Proyga Road in diverting traffic and is one of the shortest sections of Traverse Parkway at just 0.6 km long.

Proyga Section[]

This Section starts at the Proyga Stadium Road and ends at Tai Hing Road. This Section is also a section that parted from Congorge Section, and is the third shortest section in the Traverse Parkway at 1 km long.

Polywood Section[]

This Section starts at Tai Hing Road and ends at the Xofa North Link. It passes through the north of Landaiyo Shopping Mall, and is 1.3 km long. Buses at the BRT System could use the westbound part of this section, and it is 1.3 km long.

Intus Occident Section[]

This Section is the Traverse Parkway to the west of Xofa North Link to divert traffic that does not run within Peckern. As a result, the Intus Occident Gateway Road has been converted into a dead end to contain buses and traffic to and from the Gateway. The junction with Seventy Years Avenue will also be reconstructed in the future to make improvements on traffic safety. This Section is one of the shortest sections of Traverse Parkway at just 0.6 km long.

Treeless Hill Station is a station on West Ring Line and Daring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Peckern. Passengers may also use this station to change to Peckern Transit Northland Line (Treeless Hill Station) and Cities Transit Peckern City Circular (Treeless Hill Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • While Exit A was formerly connected to Treeless Hill Light Rail (NR Station), it was demolished on February 24 2018 prior to the Second Stage Upgrading Works.
  • Due to the glass floors of this station, this station has been described as a "Panchira Black Spot".
  • The side beams of this station alludes to Taiiin Hill Station in Terracept Division.

History[]

  • July 28 2015: This station began services.
  • June 112016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • February 25 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • February 2 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[6]

Tri-Swords Isle is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is an artificial island that is also a subsidiary isle of Fansim Island and is located to the west of it. This island is named after the fact that this isle is home to three towers that assemble three swords being stabbed onto the ground.

Transport[]

Despite being situated near Fansim Island, the two islands are not accessible with each other. However, future development will see Fansim Light Rail setting up a station in here, and the Pier on this isle will also be rebuilt to provide ferry services to and from different islands on West Metropolis Archipelago.

History[]

  • June 28 2016: This station completed construction.
  • June 29 2016: This station began services alongside Urban Line.
  • July 22 2020: The Urban Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[2]
  • March 9 2022: This station began expansion of the Pegasus Line part.
  • March 10 2022: The Pegasus Line part of this station completed expansion.
  • March 11 2022: Pegasus Line extends from Miner North Station to this station.
  • February 2 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[3]
  • April 18 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]
  • June 1 2025: This station is chosen as the venue for the June 2025 monthly calender.[5]
  • February 11 2026: The Station Cuisine and Station Mascot of this station are added.

title: TriPaw Terminal
safeHtml:
TriPaw Terminal is one of the piers of Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals. It is located at Los Sengas TriPaw.

Description[]

  • Terminal Number: 8
  • Location: Los Sengas TriPaw Peninsula (To the east of Miner North Station)
  • Color Scheme: Brown
  • Land Area: 66.5 Hectares
  • Coast Length: 1.469 km
  • Number of Containers: 117,200
  • Number of Cranes: 27
  • Connecting Stations: Urban Line, Pegasus Line TriPaw Station[1], Southern Corridor TriPaw Station

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • The first terminal built at the TriPaw Peninsula in Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals.
  • The second terminal used exclusively for maritime freight transport (The first such terminal is the train loading terminal in Miner Bay Depot.)

Fun Facts[]

  • The Chinese Name of this station alludes to TriPaw.
  • During the Planning Stages of this station, it was planne to be named Tri Semicolon Bay Station.[3]
  • Ultimately, this station is renamed Trisob Bay for the following reasons:
    • The emoji ;3; is widely used in the Project Nazca server and is represented by the command ":cry3:" in the Discord Server.[4]
    • It is situated next to a bay at the south of Tripaw Peninsula, and the Chinese Name of this station is modified to allude to the Chinese onomatopoeia of Tripaw Peninsula.[5]

History[]

  • November 30 2022: This station completed construction.[6]
  • December 1 2022: This station began services alongside Minecraft Line, but Pegasus Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • December 2 2022: Pegasus Line extends from Rose Garden Station to this station.

Description[]

Tung Wik Line is Line 1 of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division Shore Tip LRT. It runs along Internal Sea Shore Tip.

This route is represented by Green on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number ST-1.
